[00:15] Panpro Prozil 40, 689 stripes, 68,004 rupayalu, July varaku... to July 29 na submit chesamu. [00:24] Ippativaraku credit note raledu. Mee policy lo 30 rojulan undi kada? Maa MD gaari idi clear ayye varaku mee current invoices payment hold cheyamannaru. [00:33] Inko vishayam. translation_english: [00:00] Hello, is this the PFSizer claims desk? This is Srinivas. [00:06] I'm calling from Accounts, Matrix Medicos, Vijayawada. It's regarding claim number CLM 260702627. [00:15] Panpro Prozil 40, 689 stripes, for 68,004 rupees, was submitted on July 29th. [00:24] We haven't received the credit note yet. Your policy says 30 days, right? Our MD has asked to hold the payment for your current invoices until this is cleared. [00:33] Another thing. Your Hyderabad C&F person said that if the credit note doesn't come, to send the claim again, as it sometimes gets missed the first time. [00:40] Many parties are doing the same. Should we also resend? Also, for claims without an invoice copy, the Area Manager has given approval over the phone. [00:47] They are sending a mail. Please check and call back.

factual_claims.claim: The caller identifies himself as Srinivas from Accounts at Matrix Medicos in Vijayawada.
The call is regarding claim number CLM 260702627.
The claim is for 689 stripes of Panpro Prozil 40, with a value of 68,004 rupees.
The claim was submitted on July 29th.
A credit note for the claim has not yet been received.
The company's policy for claim processing is 30 days.
The MD of Matrix Medicos has instructed to hold payments for current invoices until the claim is cleared.
The Hyderabad C&F advised resubmitting the claim if the credit note is not received, as it might get missed.
The Area Manager has given verbal approval over the phone for claims submitted without an invoice copy.

unclear_passages.note: The speaker says 'PFSizer', which is likely a mispronunciation of 'Pfizer'. It has been transcribed as spoken.
